paragraphs: Mar Yochana son of Rav Chana bar Adda; some say Mar Yochana son of Rav Chana bar Bizna. Rava and Rav Safra came to his house—see his entry—and he prepared a choice calf (עגלא תלתא) for them: Chullin 133a.
